'''Clemens Georg Arvay'''<ref>{{Cite web|author=Andreas Schindler|url=https://fm4v3.orf.at/stories/1693992/index.html|title=''Ja, natürlich ...''|work=[[FM4|fm4v3.orf.at]]|date=31 January 2012|access-date=20 October 2020|language=de|archive-date=20 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201020074330/https://fm4v3.orf.at/stories/1693992/index.html|url-status=live}}</ref> (22 July 1980 – 18 February 2023<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bestattung-pius.at/traueranzeigen/hr-di-clemens-arvay|title=Traueranzeigen, Hr. DI Clemens Arvay|accessdate=26 February 2023|website=bestattung-pius.at|language=de-AT|archive-date=25 February 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230225074353/https://www.bestattung-pius.at/traueranzeigen/hr-di-clemens-arvay|url-status=live}}</ref>) was an Austrian author of nonfiction books with an emphasis on [[EcoHealth|health ecology]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Rooted in Nature - Biologist Clemens Arvay|url=https://bestselfmedia.com/author/clemens-g-arvay/|access-date=20 October 2020|website=Best Self Magazine|archive-date=22 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201022012409/https://bestselfmedia.com/author/clemens-g-arvay/|url-status=live}}</ref> In particular, his controversial conclusions about the relationship between the benefit and risk of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] attracted media attention.

== Biography ==
Arvay was born in 1980 in [[Graz]]. After initially undergoing an [[apprenticeship]] as a [[Bookbinding|bookbinder]]<ref>[https://www.biorama.eu/portrait-clemens-g-arvay/ Portrait Clemens G Arvay] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230226104636/https://www.biorama.eu/portrait-clemens-g-arvay/ |date=26 February 2023 }}, biorama.eu</ref> while completing [[secondary school]],<ref>{{Cite book|last=Arvay|first=Clemens|title=Mit den Bäumen wachsen wir in den Himmel: Autistische Kinder mit der Heilkraft des Waldes fördern (Forest therapy and the autism spectrum – advancing the development of children through biodiversity)|publisher=Randomhouse Germany (Goldmann)|year=2019|isbn=978-3442159895|pages=11–15}}</ref> Arvay qualified in [[landscape ecology]] at the [[University of Graz]], receiving his [[bachelor's degree]] in 2005. In 2007, he also completed his [[master's degree]] in Applied Plant Sciences at the [[University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna|University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences]] in Vienna.<ref name="About">{{Cite web|url=https://www.clemensarvay.com/about|title=About|publisher=Clemens G. Arvay|access-date=15 March 2019|archive-date=25 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190325111118/https://www.clemensarvay.com/about|url-status=live}}</ref> Arvay subsequently held various positions, including quality manager for the organic brand "Zurück zum Ursprung" (''Back to the Origin'') of the [[Aldi|Hofer]] supermarket chain.<ref>{{Cite news |language=de |title=Bio kann nicht billig sein |newspaper=[[Die Presse]] |date=5 February 2012 |page=35}}</ref> Later, Arvay temporarily obtained a position working for the Austrian environmental protection organization, Global 2000, a member of [[Friends of the Earth Europe]].<ref>{{Cite news |language=de |title=Global 2000-Mitarbeiter präsentiert: Fruchtgemüse |publisher=Austrian Presse Agentur |date=6 October 2011}}</ref> From 2012 on Arvay worked exclusively as a freelance author.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Arvay|first=Clemens|title=The Biophilia-Effect: The Healing Bond Between Humans and Nature|publisher=Sounds True Publishing|year=2018|isbn=978-1683640424|location=Boulder, Colorado|pages=86–89}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Clemens Arvay - Books|url=https://www.clemensarvay.com/books|website=clemensarvay.com|access-date=7 May 2020|archive-date=27 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200927062959/https://www.clemensarvay.com/books|url-status=live}}</ref> Some of his books became bestsellers in Germany and Austria.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Schuh|first=Karin|date=5 February 2020|title=Der Hype um die Aufdeckerbücher|journal=Die Presse|pages=35}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Berlin|first=Berliner Morgenpost-|date=23 June 2015|title=Top 10 Sachbuch aus der Amazon Bestseller-Liste|url=https://www.morgenpost.de/printarchiv/kultur/article142898802/Top-10-Sachbuch-aus-der-Amazon-Bestseller-Liste.html|access-date=18 May web|title=search result for ""Corona-Impfstoffe""|url=https://www.buchreport.de/search/%22Corona-Impfstoffe%22/|url-status=live|access-date=18 May 2021|website=buchreport (German bestseller report)|language=de-DE|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210518130726/https://www.buchreport.de/search/%22Corona-Impfstoffe%22/ |archive-date=18 May 2021 }}</ref><ref at the bottom of the cliff near the {{Interlanguage link|Türkensturz|de}} ruins, in Gleißenfeld, [[Scheiblingkirchen-Thernberg]], on February 18, 2023. His death was declared a [[suicide]].<ref name="Machl" />

== Publications ==
In 2011, Arvay published his first nonfiction book on forgotten species of vegetables. The author reached a wide readership with his second book ''Der große Bio-Schmäh'' (''The Big Organic Fraud'').<ref name=":0" /> Released in 2012, the book offered a look "behind the scenes of the supposedly picture-perfect world of organic foods,"<ref>{{Cite news |language=de |title=Blick hinter die Kulissen der heilen Bio-Welt |newspaper=Kleine Zeitung |date=26 February 2012 |page=19}}</ref> which was touted as being "a dispassionate and therefore also credible account."<ref>{{Cite news |language=de |title=Grüngewaschen: Ein neues Buch blickt hinter die Kulissen der Bio-Idylle |newspaper=Profil |date=30 January 2012 |page=73}}</ref> In 2013, in an additional book, Arvay advocated reining in "power-hungry food conglomerates" in favor of regional, small-scale farming.<ref>{{Cite news |language=de |title=Nur die regionale, kleinstrukturierte Landwirtschaft ist krisensicher |newspaper=Vorarlberger Nachrichten |date=11 March 2013}}</ref> This book also was published in Japanese.<ref>{{Cite book |title=オーガニックラベルの裏側: 21世紀食品産業の真実 |language=ja |oclc=898691505 }}</ref>

In 2014, Arvay teamed up with the actor [[Roland Düringer]] on a book titled ''Leb wohl [[Schlaraffenland]]'' (''Farewell, Land of Plenty'') in which both authors discussed the "major philosophical questions in life."<ref>{{Cite web |language=de |url=http://www.vienna.at/roland-dueringers-verzicht-experiment-leb-wohl-schlaraffenland/3833331 |title=Leb wohl, Schlaraffenland: Roland Düringers Verzicht-Experiment |author=Daniela Herger |website=Vienna Online |date=11 February 2014 |access-date=4 April 2017 |archive-date=22 June 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170622062552/http://www.vienna.at/roland-dueringers-verzicht-experiment-leb-wohl-schlaraffenland/3833331 |url-status=live }}</ref> As an experiment, Düringer decided to do without modern advances and to live according to the way things were 40 years ago.<ref>{{Cite web |language=de |url=http://www.heute.at/szene/kultur/story/21194031 |title=Düringer mit neuem Buch über Verzicht-Experiment |website=Heute |date=10 November 2013 |access-date=4 April 2017 |archive-date=27 March 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230327203555/https://www.heute.at/s/duringer-mit-neuem-buch-uber-verzicht-experiment-21194031 |url-status=live }}</ref> In the course of additional activities as an author, Arvay once again took on the ramifications of [[industrial farming]], in his book published in 2014, having to do above all with the artificial standardization of food by policymakers and industry, along with the practices of large seed producers.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |language=de |url=https://derstandard.at/1395364883446/Hilfe-unser-Essen-wird-normiert |title=Agrarbiologe warnt vor normiertem Essen |newspaper=Der Standard |date=16 April 2014 |access-date=19 June 2018 |archive-date=19 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180619190056/https://derstandard.at/1395364883446/Hilfe-unser-Essen-wird-normiert |url-status=live }}</ref>

In ''Der Biophilia-Effekt'' (''The Biophilia Effect'', 2015) and ''Das Biophilia-Training'' (''The Biophilia Training'', 2016), the author analyzed the healing effect of the forest.<ref>{{Cite news |language=de |title=Waldspaziergang schlägt Wellness |newspaper=Kronen Zeitung |date=12 April 2015 |page=44}}</ref> In the two books, Arvay touted the forest as the "best fitness gym in the world";<ref>{{Cite news |language=de |author=Julia Pflig |title=Das beste Fitnessstudio der Welt |newspaper=[[Kurier]] |date=24 April 2016 |page=34}}</ref> The English edition of The Biophilia Effect was published in 2018.<ref>{{Cite book|title=The Biophilia Effect: A Scientific and Spiritual Exploration of the Healing Bond Between Humans and Nature|oclc=991585178}}</ref> It contains a foreword by biologist [[Marc Bekoff]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.psychologytoday.com/gb/blog/animal-emotions/201801/the-biophilia-effect-exploring-the-healing-power-nature|title=The Biophilia Effect: Exploring the Healing Power of Nature|last=Marc|first=Bekoff|date=10 January 2018|website=Psychology Today|access-date=19 March 2019|archive-date=27 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230327202348/https://www.psychologytoday.com/gb/blog/animal-emotions/201801/the-biophilia-effect-exploring-the-healing-power-nature|url-status=live}}</ref> In 2016, Arvay revisited this topic in a book entitled ''Der Heilungscode der Natur'' (''The Healing Code of Nature'', 2018).<ref>{{Cite news |language=de |author=Claudia Richter |title=Hilfe aus dem Wald: Bäume als Medizin |date=4 September 2016 |newspaper=Die Presse |page=34}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://bookauthority.org/books/new-psychosomatic-medicine-books |title=5 Best New Psychosomatic Medicine Books To Read In 2019 |website=Bookauthority |access-date=25 March 2019 |archive-date=25 March 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190325111115/https://bookauthority.org/books/new-psychosomatic-medicine-books |url-status=live }}</ref> Specifically, the work discusses the positive effects of plants and animals on the [[Immune system|human immune system]].<ref>{{Cite web |language=de |url=http://www.swr.de/swr1/bw/programm/leute/arvay-clemens-biologe/-/id=1895042/did=17838394/nid=1895042/1julljb/index.html |title=Clemens Arvay, Biologe |publisher=Südwestrundfunk |date=12 August 2016 |access-date=4 April 2017 |archive-date=6 May 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170506212748/http://www.swr.de/swr1/bw/programm/leute/arvay-clemens-biologe/-/id=1895042/did=17838394/nid=1895042/1julljb/index.html |url-status=live }}</ref> His work ''Biophilia in der Stadt'' (''Biophilia in the City'', 2018) deals with the effects of nature and green spaces on urban [[public health]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Saurugger|first=Sonja|date=17 July 2018|title="Knallharte Betonflächen lösen chronischen Stress aus"|url=https://www.kleinezeitung.at/lebensart/gesundheit/5464997/Natur-in-der-Stadt_Knallharte-Betonflaechen-loesen-Stress-aus|access-date=10 June 2020|publisher=Kleine Zeitung (in German)|archive-date=10 June 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200610132720/https://www.kleinezeitung.at/lebensart/gesundheit/5464997/Natur-in-der-Stadt_Knallharte-Betonflaechen-loesen-Stress-aus|url-status=live}}</ref> Brain scientist [[Gerald Hüther]] wrote the foreword to the book.<ref>{{Cite book |language=de |url=http://d-nb.info/1144289718 |title=Katalog |year=2018 |publisher=[[German National Library]] |isbn=9783442314829 |access-date=8 June 2018 |archive-date=27 March 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230327202346/https://portal.dnb.de/opac.htm?method=simpleSearch&cqlMode=true&query=idn%3D1144289718 |url-status=live }}</ref> In the book ''Mit den Bäumen wachsen wir in den Himmel: Autistische Kinder mit der Heilkraft des Waldes fördern'' (''Forest therapy and the autism spectrum: advancing the development of children through biodiversity'', 2019), Arvay describes developmental opportunities in the forest for children on the [[autism spectrum]], supporting his explanations with current research.

In 2019, the ''International Handbook of Forest Therapy'' was published by [[Cambridge Scholars Publishing]]; it consists of two chapters that are written by Arvay.<ref>{{cite book|editor=Qing Li|title=International Handbook of Forest Therapy|publisher=Cambridge University Press|date=2019|isbn=978-1-5275-3955-6|pages=32, 42}}</ref> In 2020 he published ''Wir können es besser'' (''We Can Do Better''), claiming a correlation between environmental damages, loss of [[biodiversity]], and the emergence and spread of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Wir können es besser|url=https://www.luebbe.de/quadriga/buecher/gesundheit/wir-koennen-es-besser/id_8458398|access-date=13 September 2020|website=Bastei Luebbe Publishing Germany|language=de|archive-date=27 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201027033623/https://www.luebbe.de/quadriga/buecher/gesundheit/wir-koennen-es-besser/id_8458398|url-status=live}}</ref> Arvay's book ''Die Naturgeschichte des Immunsystems'' (''The Natural History of the Immune System'') was published in 2022 by Quadriga, [[Bastei Lübbe]]. It deals with the [[evolution]]ary development of the [[immune system]]s of [[human]]s, [[animal]]s, and [[plant]]s.<ref name="boersenblatt.net"/><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lesering.de |date=5 May 2022 |title=Spiegel Bestsellerliste: Klüpfel und Kobr mit "Affenhitze" auf Platz 1 - Aktuelles - Lesering.de |url=https://www.lesering.de/id/4905862/Spiegel-Bestsellerliste-Klupfel-und-Kobr-mit-Affenhitze-auf-Platz-1/ |access-date=17 July 2022 |website=Lesering Deutschland |archive-date=24 May 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220524083246/https://www.lesering.de/id/4905862/Spiegel-Bestsellerliste-Klupfel-und-Kobr-mit-Affenhitze-auf-Platz-1/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

== COVID-19 controversy ==
Arvay appeared as a public critic of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]s, more specifically the shortened [[Clinical trial|clinical approval process]] for the vaccine development against [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. About this issue, he published an article in the ''Swiss Medical Journal'' (''Schweizerische Ärztezeitung'') as well as a book with the title ''Corona-Impfstoffe: Rettung oder Risiko?'' (''Corona vaccines: rescue or risk?'', [[Bastei Lübbe|Bastei Luebbe]], 2021).<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Arvay |first=Clemens |date=July 1, 2020 |title=Genetische Impfstoffe gegen COVID-19: Hoffnung oder Risiko? |url=https://saez.ch/article/doi/saez.2020.18982 |journal=Schweizerische Ärztezeitung |language=de-CH |volume=101 |issue=2728 |pages=862–864 |doi=10.4414/saez.2020.18982 |doi-access=free |access-date=March 26, 2023 |archive-date=15 December 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201215052145/https://saez.ch/article/doi/saez.2020.18982 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Dörhöfer |first=Pamela |date=8 April 2021 |title=Clemens Arvay: Bestseller über Corona-Impfstoffe |url=https://www.fr.de/wissen/clemens-avray-corona-impfstoffe-impfen-virologe-90335633.html |website=Frankfurter Rundschau |language=de-DE |access-date=March 26, 2023 |archive-date=7 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210407171400/https://www.fr.de/wissen/clemens-avray-corona-impfstoffe-impfen-virologe-90335633.html |url-status=live }}</ref> He was invited to a panel discussion on Austrian public television [[ORF (broadcaster)|ORF]] to talk about these concerns in November 2020<ref>{{Cite web |title=Talk 1: Jetzt wird getestet und geimpft – War das der letzte Lockdown? Mit Florian Aigner, Clemens G. Arvay, Christina Nicolodi, Bernhard Kittel u. a. |url=https://tv.orf.at/highlights/orf1/201125_talk1_100.html |date=November 25, 2020 |access-date=March 26, 2023 |website=tv.ORF.at |language=de-AT |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201125203042/https://tv.orf.at/highlights/orf1/201125_talk1_100.html |archive-date=25 November 2020 |url-status=live }}{{YouTube|id=7gBoed0jUlU}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Talk 1: Jetzt wird getestet und geimpft – War das der letzte Lockdown?|url=https://www.ots.at/presseaussendung/OTS_20201124_OTS0182/talk-1-jetzt-wird-getestet-und-geimpft-war-das-der-letzte-lockdown|date=November 24, 2020|access-date=December 6, 2020|website=OTS.at|language=de-AT|archive-date=24 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201124152415/https://www.ots.at/presseaussendung/OTS_20201124_OTS0182/talk-1-jetzt-wird-getestet-und-geimpft-war-das-der-letzte-lockdown|url-status=live}}</ref> and posted several related videos on his [[YouTube]] channel, which were deleted by him later. According to Arvay, in [[Animal testing|animal experiments]] the vaccine candidate [[AZD1222]] did not achieve sufficient protection against the [[infection]] and led to significant side effects in the combined clinical phases I/II. Fabian Schmidt wrote in [[Deutsche Welle]] that Arvay drew a narrative according to which the [[pharmaceutical industry]] and investors such as [[Bill Gates]] wanted to bring the vaccines to the market at any price and for profit, even if they put [[public health]] at risk.<ref>{{Cite web |author=Fabian Schmidt |work=[[Deutsche Welle]] |url=https://www.dw.com/de/covid-19-schwierige-abw%C3%A4gungen-bei-der-entwicklung-von-impfstoffen/a-55123033 |title=COVID-19: Schwierige Abwägungen bei der Entwicklung von Impfstoffen |date=October 19, 2020 |access-date=March 26, 2023 |language=de-DE |archive-date=29 November 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201129051628/https://www.dw.com/de/covid-19-schwierige-abw%C3%A4gungen-bei-der-entwicklung-von-impfstoffen/a-55123033 |url-status=live }}</ref>

The German [[Virology|virologist]] Stephan Becker, who was involved in the vaccine study in the early stages, did not share Arvay's concerns about a lack of care. For him, the test data in animals and humans showed a desired [[immune response]]. In contrast to Arvay, Becker considered the side effects shown so far to be acceptable, but advised carefully considering whether the risk for a patient outweighs the protection against the coronavirus infection.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Welle (www.dw.com)|first=Deutsche|title=COVID-19: Schwierige Abwägungen bei der Entwicklung von Impfstoffen {{!}} DW {{!}} 19 October 2020|url=https://www.dw.com/de/covid-19-schwierige-abw%C3%A4gungen-bei-der-entwicklung-von-impfstoffen/a-55123033|access-date=6 December 2020|website=DW.COM|language=de-DE|archive-date=29 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201129051628/https://www.dw.com/de/covid-19-schwierige-abw%C3%A4gungen-bei-der-entwicklung-von-impfstoffen/a-55123033|url-status=live}}</ref> In an article in the Austrian newspaper ''[[Falter]]'', Barbara Tóth sees Arvay as a "classic Corona free rider" who also used criticism of the containment measures against COVID-19 as a business model.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Aluhut, Globuli und Judenstern|url=https://www.falter.at/zeitung/20200915/aluhut-globuli-und-judenstern|access-date=6 December 2020|website=www.falter.at|archive-date=11 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201011093458/https://www.falter.at/zeitung/20200915/aluhut-globuli-und-judenstern|url-status=live}}</ref>
 	
According to the [[Robert Koch Institute]] (RKI), all COVID-19 vaccines approved in the [[European Union]] are safe, effective, and overall have a good risk-benefit profile according to the current state of science (1 April 2021).<ref>{{Cite web|date=1 April 2021|title=STIKO-Empfehlung zur COVID-19-Impfung|url=https://www.rki.de/DE/Content/Infekt/EpidBull/Archiv/2021/Ausgaben/16_21.pdf?__blob=publicationFile|url-status=live|access-date=10 April 2021|website=Robert Koch Institute|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210408182040/https://www.rki.de/DE/Content/Infekt/EpidBull/Archiv/2021/Ausgaben/16_21.pdf?__blob=publicationFile |archive-date=8 April 2021 }}</ref>
